title: feat: ConfigPanel disabledWhen, expandedSections, description spec alignment, navigation hints
body:
Addresses several ViewConfigPanel/ConfigPanelRenderer detail issues: missing `disabled` state for view-type-dependent fields, no external collapse control, `description` not in protocol spec, and no UX hints on conditionally-visible navigation fields. ### Protocol alignment - Add `description?: string` to `NamedListView` interface — was annotated as "UI extension", now spec-aligned ### `disabledWhen` predicate on `ConfigField` - New `disabledWhen?: (draft) => boolean` on `ConfigField` type - Evaluated in `ConfigFieldRenderer` as `effectiveDisabled` for all control types (input, switch, checkbox, select, slider, color, icon-group, field-picker) - Grid-only fields (`striped`, `bordered`, `wrapHeaders`, `resizable`) now disabled when `type !== 'grid'` ```tsx // buildSwitchField now accepts optional disabledWhen buildSwitchField('striped', t('...'), 'toggle-striped', false, true, (draft) => draft.type != null && draft.type !== 'grid') ``` ### `expandedSections` prop on `ConfigPanelRenderer` - New `expandedSections?: string[]` prop overrides local collapsed state for listed section keys - Enables external callers to programmatically open/highlight specific sections ### Navigation-dependent field hints - `helpText` added to `_navigationWidth` and `_navigationOpenNewTab` fields - New i18n keys `navigationWidthHint` / `openNewTabHint` translated across all 11 locales - `ConfigFieldRenderer` renders `helpText` as a `

` element below the field control for all field types including `custom` ### Tests - 27 new tests: `expandedSections` override (3), `disabledWhen` evaluation (2), grid-only predicates (16), helpText validation (2), description spec alignment (1), helpText rendering in ConfigFieldRenderer (3) - All 283 related tests passing

Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > ViewConfigPanel 部分控件细节问题及改进建议 > 经对 ViewConfigPanel/ConfigPanelRenderer 代码以及控件交��/协议字段适配进行精查，发现如下问题值得追踪修复： > > 1. > 控件 key/属性 与协议 NamedListView 字段 ⚠️ 不严格一致：部分场景（如单测、或历史逻辑）仍出现 selection.type/multi 与 multiple 混用，建议统一 key 为 multiple。 > > 2. > 部分 UI extension 字段未全在协议 spec 体现（如 description）。建议推进协议补全相关定义。 > > 3. > 部分设置字段是通过 visibleWhen 实现条件可见，但 UI 文案提示及状态同步逻辑不足，例如导航模式切换下 dependent 字段状态无提示。 > > 4. > ConfigPanelSchema Section/Field 的 collapsed 状态仅由本地 state 控制，未能支持外部打开指定Section的自动聚焦或高亮体验。 > > 5. > Switch/Checkbox/Input 等基础控件依赖简化 mock 组件（如测试/故事文件中代码），实际复杂场景可用性及可访问性还需生产环境下多端深测。 > > 6. > 部分控件显示/隐藏仅依赖 visibleWhen，但缺乏 "disabled" 受控属性，会导致一些配置项在 protocol 不支持情况下未置灰。 > > 请相关研发、产品和前端同学评估上述问题，逐项讨论优先级并逐步推进完善。 > > 如有新增控件细节 bug 或 UX 良性建议，请补充到本 issue 下面。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
